blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Building a language model of one's own no longer requires a data centre. This tutorial trains one from scratch, tokenizer included, on one consumer GPU, and shows how to tell whether it is good for the tasks of a specialist domain. It proposes no new method. It releases a tested Python package and two notebooks in Brazilian Portuguese with autoregressive and masked diffusion generation on one network, a preregistered comparison protocol, legal tasks built from text alone with a Kneser-Ney floor and public yardsticks, reference numbers for models of 11 to 12M parameters, and a catalogue of defects that only measurement revealed. On Brazilian prose and federal laws, at minutes per run, the autoregressive mode peaks at 64 epochs over the same text and then memorises it, while masked diffusion improves up to 256. At their best points on test, the diffusion bound exceeds the autoregressive likelihood by 0.06 bits per byte, within the preregistered minimum effect. On held-out laws and on acts published after training, the model ties a 6-gram floor in likelihood on the same windows, and it loses to the floor at continuing those acts. It beats the floor at detecting tampered text, and fills cross-references more often than the floor and public models of 160M and 630M parameters, only in decrees, a genre absent from training, where those scorers stay near or below chance, and in filling the blank only when each group weighs the same, since per item it ties the 630M model. On laws, the public models, trained with about 5x10^2 to 10^5 times its compute, lead in tampered text and continuation. The blind human reading is preregistered and not part of this version.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Many people who need a language model for a narrow domain, such as the laws of one country, the records of one hospital or the literature of one period, face the same question. Is it possible to train a model of one’s own, from nothing, on a home computer, and obtain something that is actually good for the tasks at hand? Most learning material does not answer it, because it starts from a model someone else pretrained. A checkpoint is downloaded and a library fine-tunes it, and the learner rarely sees where the loss comes from, how the tokenizer was built, or how to know whether a fluent sample reflects learning or recitation of the training text. Adapting a small pretrained model remains a strong road when one exists for the language. Di Oliveira et al. [2024] fine-tuned TeenyTinyLlama [ Corrêa et al., 2024a ] , a small model pretrained on Brazilian Portuguese, to the Mercosur Common Nomenclature, a specialist customs domain, and compared it with GPT-4 on questions held out from training. This tutorial takes the other road, training from nothing, which is the one left when no pretrained model fits the language, the period or the vocabulary of the domain, and the one that keeps every step visible.

blocks.en: This tutorial answers the question with a complete, measured example. It builds a small language model (SLM) by hand, from the raw text to the generated samples, and evaluates it against references that give meaning to its numbers. The reader who follows it ends with three things. The first is a working pipeline, a Python package and two notebooks that run each step with its input and output shown. The second is a way to adapt the pipeline to a corpus of their own by editing a configuration and a domain adapter. The third is an evaluation protocol that says whether the resulting model is good, compared with what, and for which tasks.
blocks.zh: 此教程以完整,有分量的例子解答问题. 它用手构建出从原始文本到生成样品的小型语言模型(SLM),并根据赋予其数字意义的引用来评价. 随顺之所念者以三事而为止. 第一个是工作管道、Python软件包和两个笔记本,每个步骤都有输入和输出。 第二个方法是通过编辑一个配置和一个域适配器来使管道适应他们自己的一套程序。 第三是评价协议,说明由此产生的模式是否良好,与什么相比,以及哪些任务。

blocks.en: The tutorial proposes no new method, and its value lies in putting known pieces together where each can be checked. Masked diffusion in the number-of-masks form follows Ou et al. [2024] and Nie et al. [2025] , the floor is interpolated modified Kneser–Ney smoothing [ Chen and Goodman, 1996 ] , the statistics are standard, and the protocol borrows preregistration and checks before results from good practice in empirical research [ van Miltenburg et al., 2021 ; Dodge et al., 2019 ] . What a reader can reuse, and cite, is the assembly, in five parts. C1, package and notebooks. The slm package, eleven modules each guarded by tests ( Table 2 ), and two notebooks that run it step by step, one per generation mode, written for the free GPU of Colab. The reproduction on that GPU is not part of this version. Code identifiers and notebooks are in Portuguese, and Table 2 glosses each module. C2, comparison protocol. Checks with criteria fixed before the measurement, preregistrations frozen by their SHA-256 hash, a minimum effect, a seed count derived from a pilot and dated amendments ( Section 7 , folder preregistro ). C3, task kit. Four legal tasks built by a script from the text of 1,094 federal acts published in 2025 and 2026, with no human labelling, the item hashes and the scoring rule, which place a home-built model between a Kneser–Ney floor and public models ( Section 6.3 , folder tarefas ). C4, reference numbers. Bits per byte, task scores and calibration for models of 11 to 12M parameters trained on a few megabytes of text, with seeds, intervals and the floor scored on the same windows, each reproducible on one GPU in minutes ( Section 8 , folders runs and resultados ). C5, catalogue of defects. The defects that only measurement revealed, each with the check that detected it and the test that now guards it ( Section 9 ).

blocks.en: The model has two generation modes on one network. The autoregressive mode predicts each token from the previous ones with causal attention. The masked diffusion mode [ Austin et al., 2021 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Ou et al., 2024 ; Nie et al., 2025 ] predicts masked tokens from the visible ones with bidirectional attention. The only differences between the two are the attention mask and the loss, so the tutorial can teach both with the same code, and a measured difference between them comes from training and generation, not from the network.

blocks.en: The worked example uses two Portuguese corpora. The first, the prose of Machado de Assis, has a recognisable style and serves to demonstrate each step. The second, Brazilian federal legislation, is the specialist domain on which usefulness is measured. All runs used one consumer GPU under a 500 W power cap, one run at a time.

Section 6 explains how to evaluate the model, which is the centre of the tutorial. Section 7 explains how to compare configurations so that a difference can be trusted. blocks.en: 2 Related resources
blocks.zh: 2 相关资源

blocks.en: Several resources already teach how to build a language model by hand, and a reader choosing among them needs to know what each one covers. Table 1 compares them on axes that can be checked in their papers and repositories. The Annotated Transformer [ Rush, 2018 ] set the format of code that reads alongside the paper it implements. nanoGPT [ Karpathy, 2022 ] is the reference for a short autoregressive training loop. Cramming [ Geiping and Goldstein, 2022 ] trains a masked encoder on one GPU in one day, with a tokenizer built from its own data. TinyStories [ Eldan and Li, 2023 ] shows that models under 10M parameters can produce fluent text on a simplified synthetic corpus, graded by a large model, and the BabyLM challenges [ Warstadt et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2024 ] compare pretraining on about 10M to 100M words under a shared evaluation, where in the second edition a hybrid causal and masked model ranked first. None of these covers a language other than English, two generation modes on one network, a floor and tasks for a specialist domain, or preregistration. Those four are what this tutorial adds, and in return it covers less ground than any of them on scale, on architecture variants and on breadth of benchmarks.

blocks.en: 5 Building the model step by step
blocks.zh: 页:1 逐步建立模式

blocks.en: The pipeline has eleven steps, called boxes and numbered 0 to 10 ( Table 2 ). Each box is at once a module of the package and a section of each notebook, and each module depends only on the boxes before it. The notebooks import the package instead of reimplementing it, so the code that trained the reported runs is the code a student executes in class. Each notebook section has three parts, the theory with its formulas, the executed code with input and output, and the technique, with the problems met in the project and the measurement that revealed them.
blocks.zh: 管道有11个步骤,称为箱并编号为0至10(表2)。 每个盒子同时是包件的一个模块和每个笔记本的一个部分,每个模块只取决于之前的盒子. 笔记本导入了软件包而不是重新执行,所以训练所报运行的代码是学生在课堂上执行的代码. 每个笔记本部分分三个部分,理论及其公式,被执行的有输入和输出的代码,以及技术,项目遇到的问题和揭示这些问题的测量.

blocks.en: Table 2: The eleven boxes of the pipeline, their modules with an English gloss of each Portuguese name, and the checks that guard them. The decision documents of the repository define each check.
blocks.zh: 表2:管道的11个箱、每个葡萄牙名有英文拼音的模块以及守卫它们的检查。 寄存器的决定文件定义了每次检查.

blocks.en: 5.1 Corpus
blocks.zh: 5.1 企业

blocks.en: The first corpus (A) is the prose of Machado de Assis in the Project Gutenberg, ten works after removing Poesias completas and Relíquias de casa velha , the latter because it contains a sonnet and two comedies. Cleaning keeps the original spelling and normalises the text to NFC once, before anything else. The split uses contiguous blocks of whole chapters per work, one for validation and one for test, separated by a discarded margin chapter, with at least 5 chapters and 30 KB per block, so that neighbouring chapters never fall on both sides. Nine works enter the test partition, and Papéis avulsos stays in training and validation only, because its twelve stories cannot hold two blocks of five, two margins and a training block. Training holds 2.22 MB and 624,377 tokens, validation 153,756 tokens and test 133,520.
blocks.zh: 第一部(A)是马查多·德·阿西斯(Machado de Assis)在"古腾堡计划"中的传道人,在移除了"Poesias Completas"和"Relíquias de Casa velha"后有十出作品,后一出作品是因为其中包含一首相声和两首喜剧. 清理保持了原始拼法,并将文本正常化为NFC一次,先于事出. 分块使用每个作品的整章相接的块,一个用于验证,一个用于测试,用一个被丢弃的比值章相隔,每个块至少有5章和30KB,这样相邻的分块就不会倒入两侧. 有9部作品进入了测试分区,而Papéis avulsos只留在培训和验证中,因为其12个故事不能占据两个5个街区,两个边缘和一个训练区. 训练持有2.22 MB和624,377个令牌,验证153,756个令牌并测试133,520个.

blocks.en: The specialist corpus (B) is Brazilian federal legislation, ordinary laws from 2019 to 2022 of the substantive and amending classes. Laws that open budget credits, set budgets or pay homage were removed, because their text repeats a formula from one law to the next. The corpus holds 4.76 MB in 441 laws, collected from the official compiled pages with struck-out text and editorial notes removed. All 444 pages of the two classes were collected, and three laws left the corpus because they are wholly repealed and their compiled page has no text in force. Each law joins the group of the first law cited in its summary, near-copies are merged by MinHash, and a whole group goes to a single partition, so that a law and the law it amends do not fall on both sides. Both texts are in the public domain or are official acts without copyright protection under Brazilian law, and the repository versions them with a manifest of URLs, hashes and collection dates, so the notebooks download nothing beyond the repository. The largest group of corpus B, Law 14,133 on public procurement, holds 5.78% of its bytes. A third set, built by the same adapter, holds the 300 ordinary laws of the same two classes published in 2025 and 2026, 163 amending and 137 substantive, 2.36 MB in 229 groups, where the largest group holds 10.9% of the bytes. No model in this tutorial can have seen these laws, neither the one trained here, whose corpus ends in 2022, nor the public models used as yardstick, all published before 2025, so this external set carries the evaluation of usefulness. The tasks of Section 6.3 enlarge it with the complementary laws and decrees of the same years.
blocks.zh: 专家委托书(B)是巴西联邦立法,是2019年至2022年实质性和修正类的普通法. 开放预算信贷、确定预算或致敬的法律被删除,因为它们的案文重复了一部法律中的公式。 从官方编译的网页上收集的471部法律中,该教士拥有4.76 MB,删除了删除的删除文本和编辑说明。 两个类别中,总共收集了444页,有三项法律因为被完全废除而留下了文书,其汇编的网页没有生效。 每部法律都加入其摘要所引用的第一部法律的组别,近影由明·哈什(MinHash)合并而成,整个组别到一分法中去,这样它所修正的一部法律和一部法律就不会落在两侧. 这两个文本都属于公有领域,或者是官方行为,根据巴西法律没有版权保护,寄存器的版本包含有URL,散列和收藏日期的列表,因此笔记本只下载了寄存器以外的任何内容. 关于公共采购的第14.133号法律,B类中最大的实体占其字节的5.78%。 第三套由同名适配器所建造,持有2025年和2026年公布的同名两个类的300个普通定律,163个修正和137个实质性的,2.36个MB分出229个组,其中最大的组拥有10.9%的字节. 在这个教程中,没有任何模式能够看到这些法律,无论是在这里训练的,其教程于2022年结束,还是作为衡量标准的公共模式,都于2025年之前公布,因此,这个外部集带有对效用的评价. 第6.3节的任务随着同年的补充法律和法令而扩大。

The group is the unit that must never be split across partitions, such as a work, a law and the laws it amends, or a patient. Measure the partitions before training anything.

blocks.en: 5.2 Tokenizer
blocks.zh: 5.2 切除剂

blocks.en: The tokenizer is byte-level BPE [ Sennrich et al., 2015 ] with the GPT-2 pre-tokenisation pattern [ Radford et al., 2019 ] , trained only on the training partition. A tokenizer from a library is fast, and one written by hand teaches the algorithm, so the tutorial keeps both and requires them to agree. With a written tie-breaking convention, the didactic BPE and the tokenizers library 0.23.3 produce the same merges and the same ids on held-out text. The vocabulary size is chosen before any model training as the largest value in { 1024 , 2048 , 4096 , 8192 } \{1024,2048,4096,8192\} with at most 10% of the learned tokens absent from the held-out text, which keeps rarely seen rows out of the embedding [ Land and Bartolo, 2024 ] . The rule gives V = 4096 V=4096 on corpus A and V = 1024 V=1024 on corpus B. The tokenizer sits behind a contract of six tests, and a trivial tokenizer of 260 byte ids passes them without any change to the package, so another tokenizer can replace BPE.
blocks.zh: 标致器为字节级BPE [Sennrich等,2015年] 有GPT-2预接模式[Radford等,2019年],仅接受训练分出. 一个从库中取出的信使是快的,一个用手写来教导算法,所以教程既保留了两者,也要求他们同意. 有了书面的打结会,Dactic BPE和活化剂库0.233在被搁置的文本上产生同样的合并和相同的ID. 词汇大小在任何模式训练之前被选择为{1024, 2048, 4096, 8192}} {1024, 2048, 4096, 8192} 中最大的值, 其中最多10%的已学习到的符号没有出现在被搁置的文本中, 这让嵌入文本中很少看到行出 [Land and Bartolo, 2024]. 该规则给予V=4096 V=4096关于A和V=1024 V=1024关于B。 标致器坐落在一份6个测试的合约后,而一个260字节的标致器在包裹没有任何改变的情况下通过它们,因此另一个标致器可以取代BPE.

blocks.en: Adapting to another domain. Train the tokenizer on the new training partition and apply the vocabulary rule to its own held-out text. A smaller or more repetitive corpus will usually select a smaller vocabulary, as corpus B did.
blocks.zh: 适应另一个域. 在新训练分区上训练示意器,并将词汇规则应用到自己的被搁置文本上. 较小或更重复的体会通常会像体会B那样选择较小的词汇.

blocks.en: 5.3 Windows
blocks.zh: 5.3 视窗

blocks.en: Each document is cut into windows of exactly L = 256 L=256 tokens, aligned to its start, with [EOS] at the end and padding up to L L . Both modes predict every position, padding included, with the nats counted and zero bytes, and documents are never concatenated. Padding occupies 12.2% of the training positions at L = 256 L=256 , against 6.3% at 128 and 22.5% at 512, a measurement made before fixing L L .
blocks.zh: 每个文档被切入完全由L = 256 L = 256个令牌组成的窗口,与开始一致,结尾处有[EOS]并被固定到L L. 两种模式都预言每个位置,包括平分,并计有nat和0字节,文档永远不会被调和. 佩丁占培训职位的12.2%(L=256L=256),而占6.3%(128)和22.5%(512),这是在固定LL之前作出的衡量。

blocks.en: 5.4 Network
blocks.zh: 5.4 网络

blocks.en: A pre-LayerNorm Transformer with 6 layers, d = 384 d=384 , 6 heads, learned positions, a GELU MLP of width 4 ​ d 4d , embedding tied to the output layer [ Press and Wolf, 2016 ] and no time input. It has 10.6M non-embedding parameters, 12.3M in total with V = 4096 V=4096 and 11.1M with V = 1024 V=1024 . The [MASK] logit is fixed at − ∞ -\infty in both modes, so the model never predicts the mask token. Dropout acts on the embedding, the attention weights and both residual branches.

blocks.en: 5.5 Training
blocks.zh: 5.5 培训

blocks.en: AdamW with β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta=(0.9,0.95) , weight decay 0.1, gradient clipping at 1.0, linear warm-up over 2% of the steps and a cosine schedule closed on the run’s own length, batch 64. Each training budget is its own run, because intermediate checkpoints of a long cosine run are undertrained for the budget they represent [ Hoffmann et al., 2022 , Appendix B] . Training runs in fp16 with fp32 master weights and gradient scaling [ Micikevicius et al., 2017 ] , the loss in fp32 over the logits, and the attention kernel fixed to the same implementation on every machine. The budget counts applied steps only, and a step skipped by the scaler repeats the same batch, so the two modes see the same data in the same order.
blocks.zh: 亚当W与β=(0.9,0.95)\β=(0.9,0.95),重量衰减0.1,梯度剪接为1.0,线性取暖超过2%的步道和在跑道自有长度上关闭的余弦表, 第64批. 每项培训预算都是自己的业务,因为长余弦运行的中间检查站对它们所代表的预算训练不足[Hoffmann等,2022年,附录B]。 训练在fp16中运行,有fp32主重和梯度缩放[Micikevicius等,2017年],fp32中损失超过对数,注意内核固定在每个机器上相同的执行. 预算计数只应用了步骤,一个步骤被缩放器跳过,重复了相同的批次,因此两种模式以相同的顺序看到相同的数据.

blocks.en: 6 Evaluating the model

blocks.en: A model is good only in relation to something and for some purpose. The evaluation therefore has three layers. Likelihood says how well the model predicts unseen text of the domain. References give that number a meaning, by placing the model between a classical floor and a larger public model. Tasks and the quality of the samples say whether the model is useful.
blocks.zh: 一个模型只有在某种事物和某种目的上才是好的. 因此,评价分为三层。 可能说模型对域外文字的预测有多好。 参考文献通过将模型放在古典地板和更大的公共模型之间,赋予了这个数字一个意义. 任务和样本的质量都表明模型是否有用.

blocks.en: 6.1 Likelihood in bits per byte
blocks.zh: 6.1 每字节以比特表示的可能性

blocks.en: Both modes are evaluated in bits per byte on the validation partition, as a ratio of sums over documents, bpb = ∑ d nats d ln ⁡ 2 ⋅ ∑ d bytes d , \mathrm{bpb}=\frac{\sum_{d}\text{nats}_{d}}{\ln 2\cdot\sum_{d}\text{bytes}_{d}}, (3) with the bytes counted on the normalised text. The unit does not depend on the tokenizer, so models with different tokenizers, including the reference models below, are measured on the same scale. For the autoregressive mode the nats are the exact negative log-likelihood. For masked diffusion they are the NELBO estimated with the number-of-masks form in fp32, every window evaluated once, which is an upper bound on the true value. The windows are disjoint, each restarts its context, and the padding is predicted and counted, a design that closes the length leak between the modes ( Section 9 ). These bits per byte are therefore not comparable with evaluations that slide a window over running text, as is usual in the literature.
blocks.zh: 两种模式在验证分区上以每字节的比特值评价,作为对文件的金额比例, bpb = ∑ d nats d in ⁡ 2 ⋅ d 字节,\mathrm{ bpb}=\frac\ sum_{d}\text{nats}_{d}}{\ln 2\cdot\ sum \\ d\ text{字节\ d}(3) 字节数在正态文本上 。 单位不依赖于活化剂,因此不同活化剂的模型,包括下面的参考模型,都是在同一尺度上测量的. 对于自递性模式,Nats是准确的负对数相似. 对于被遮住的传播来说,它们是以fp32的量子形式估计的NELBO,每个窗口评估一次,这是真实值上方的束缚. 窗口是脱节的,每个窗口都会重启其上下文,并预想并计算出粘接符,这个设计可以关闭模式之间的长度漏出(第9节. 因此,这些每字节的比特与从窗口滑出运行中文本的评价不相上下,这在文献中是常见的.

blocks.en: The bound makes the comparison between the modes asymmetric, and the reading is fixed before any run. With Δ = bpb dif − bpb AR \Delta=\mathrm{bpb}_{\mathrm{dif}}-\mathrm{bpb}_{\mathrm{AR}} , an interval below zero means that diffusion is better in likelihood. An interval above zero means that the autoregressive mode beats the diffusion bound, with no conclusion about the true likelihood of diffusion. An interval containing zero is inconclusive.
blocks.zh: 绑定使模式不对称的比较,读取在任何运行之前是固定的. 以 QQ = bpb dif = bpb AR = Delta =\ mathrm { bpb}_{\- mathrm { dif}}-\ mathrm { bpb}_{\- mathrm { AR}} } 为单位,零以下的间隔意味着扩散的可能性更好. 间隔超过0表示自递回模式会比扩散绑定,对扩散的真实可能性没有结论. 包含 0 的间隔没有定论 。

blocks.en: 6.2 Reference points
blocks.zh: 6.2 参考点

blocks.en: Two references bracket the model. The floor is an n-gram model with interpolated modified Kneser–Ney smoothing [ Chen and Goodman, 1996 ] trained on the same training partition and tokens, the classical method for small corpora, which a neural model must beat to show that it learned more than counts. The package implements it in a few dozen lines, with the same didactic purpose as the hand-written BPE, and two tests guard it. Every conditional distribution sums to one within 10 − 12 10^{-12} , in seen and unseen contexts, and the probabilities equal those of a second, direct implementation of the formulas. The order is chosen on validation from 3 to 6. On corpus A it is 5, although orders 4 to 6 differ by 0.0003 bits per byte, so the choice is immaterial. On corpus B it is 6, the end of the grid, where the value was still falling. Training takes seconds on one CPU core. The floor has two values, and both are reported. Scored on running text, as a reader who uses it as a tool would, it reaches 1.833 bits per byte on corpus A, and 1.038 on validation, 1.046 on test and 1.206 on the external laws of 2025 and 2026 on corpus B. Scored on the same windows of 256 tokens as the Transformer, with the context restarted and the padding predicted, it reaches 1.841 on corpus A and 1.066 on corpus B, and 1.234 on the external laws. The comparison with the Transformer always uses the second value, which is the one to cite as the floor of this protocol. The yardstick is a larger public language model pretrained on general Portuguese text and used only for evaluation, never for training, measured on the same validation text in bits per byte. TeenyTinyLlama [ Corrêa et al., 2024a ] , already adapted to a specialist Portuguese domain by Di Oliveira et al. [2024] , is a natural candidate. A small model built for the domain that comes close to the yardstick, or passes it, shows that domain data can substitute for size. The public yardstick must not have seen the evaluation text. Tucano draws on a legal corpus with federal bills, and the Common Crawl snapshot of early 2023 holds 191 pages of laws from 2019 to 2022 on the official site, so on corpus B the yardstick is measured on the external acts only. Three yardsticks are used, TeenyTinyLlama 160M, Tucano 160M and Tucano 630M [ Corrêa et al., 2024a ; Corrêa et al., 2024b ] , at pinned revisions. Before any number, their 16-bit logits were compared with fp32 on 64 items, with a mean absolute difference of 0.003 nats per token and a maximum of 0.13, and the measurement itself ran in fp32. Their tokenizer drops the ordinal indicators º and ª, frequent in legal text, which amounts to 0.40% of the bytes of the continuation task. Charging 16 bits for each dropped character would move a yardstick by at most 0.03 bits per byte, which is reported rather than corrected.
blocks.zh: 两个参考文献将模型置于括号内。 地板是一个n克模型,内插了修改过的克内斯-尼平滑[Chen and Goodman, 1996] , 训练了相同的训练分和符, 小蝎子的古典方法, 一个神经模型必须击败它才能显示它学到了比数更多的东西. 包裹以几十行来执行,与手写BPE的教学目的相同,并有两道测试来守卫. 每一次有条件的分配,在10 - 12 10 - 12} 内,在可见和不见的情况下,其概率等于直接执行公式的第二次分配。 该顺序从3到6在审定时选定. 血压A是5,尽管4到6的订单是每字节0.03个比特,所以选择无关紧要。 血压B是6, 电网末端,值仍在下降。 在一个CPU核心上训练需要几秒钟. 下限有两个数值,两者都报告. 作为使用文字作为工具的读者,在运行的文字上得分,在A项上达到每字节1.833个比特;在验证上达到1.038个比特;在测试上达到1.046个比特;在2025年的外部法律上达到1.206个比特;在B项上达到1.226个比特;在与变形器相同的256个比特的窗口上得分,在上下文重新开始并预测到附加,在A项上达到1.841个比特;在B项上达到1.066个比特;在外部法律上达到1.234个比特。 与"变形器"的比较总是使用第二个值,这个值是作为本协议下限引用的. 衡量标准是一个较大的公共语言模式,它预先在普通葡萄牙语文本上进行训练,并且仅用于评价,从未用于训练,在相同的验证文本上以比特/字节衡量。 少女蒂尼拉玛 [Corrêa et al., 2024a],已经由Di Oliveira et al. [2024] 改编而成的葡萄牙专业领域,是天生的候选者. 一个为域所建的小模型,它接近于标尺,或者通过它,表明域数据可以代替大小. 公共尺度一定没有看到评价文本。 图卡诺借鉴了包含联邦法案的法律文书,2023年初的"共同爬行快照"在官方网站上收录了从2019年到2022年的191页法律,因此在命案B上,衡量标准只用外部行为来衡量. 使用了三个标准,即TeenyTinyLlama 160M、Tucano 160M和Tucano 630M[Corrêa等,2024a;Corrêa等,2024b],在被标注的修订上。 在任何数字之前,他们的16位对数在64个项目上被比作fp32,平均绝对差为每令牌0.003纳特,最高0.13,测量本身运行在fp32. 它们的标注器会降低正数指标o和 a,在法律文本中经常出现,相当于续作任务的字节的0.40%. 对每个被丢弃的字符充电16比特,将移动一个标准,每字节充电最多0.03比特,报告而不是纠正。

blocks.en: 6.3 Tasks in the legal domain
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 法律领域的任务

blocks.en: Likelihood on validation says how well the model predicts text like its training text. Usefulness is asked of text the model cannot have seen, so the tasks are built on an external set of federal acts published in 2025 and 2026, after the training laws and after every public model used here. It holds 1,094 acts, 300 ordinary laws, 27 complementary laws and 767 decrees, of the substantive and amending classes, grouped as in corpus B so that a decree that regulates a law falls in the group of that law, 855 groups in all. Every task is built by a script from the text alone, with no human labelling, and each item is scored by every model through the same rule, the log-probability of a candidate text given its context.
blocks.zh: 对验证的偏好表示模型对文本如其训练文本的预测有多好. 要求使用这个模型无法见到的文本,因此这些任务建立在2025年和2026年公布的一套外部联邦法令、培训法和在此使用的每一个公共模型之后。 它拥有1,094项法令、300项普通法律、27项补充法律和767项法令,它们属于实质性和修正类别,被归为B类,因此管理一项法律的法令属于该法类别,共有855个群体。 每个任务都由单从文本中创建出一个脚本,没有人类标签,每个项目都由每个模型通过相同的规则来打分,即从上下文看候选文本的日志概率.

blocks.en: A number written in the legal pair “N (in words)” or the number of a cross-reference such as “art. N” is deleted from an article, and the model chooses among four candidates with the same number of tokens. Number distractors come from the numbers of the training text with the same grammatical gender, and cross-reference distractors from the other articles cited by the same act. The metric is accuracy, with chance at 0.25.
blocks.zh: 以“N(用字)”或“第N条”等相互参照的编号写成的编号从一篇文章中去掉,该模型从4名具有相同编号的候选者中选择。 数字分出者来自具有相同语法性别的训练文本的编号,并交叉引用了同一行为所引用的其他条款分出者. 衡量标准是准确的,概率为0.25.

blocks.en: An amending law inserts provisions into another law, quoted in its own text, and also has provisions of its own. Given the head of an article, the model decides which of the two it is. The score is the difference in log-probability of the text after an insertion formula (“passa a vigorar com a seguinte redação”) and after a plain article heading, and the threshold is fitted on training items for balanced accuracy, the metric of the task, since only 313 of the 3,095 external items are inserted. T2 was preregistered as confirmatory and is read as exploratory, for the reason given in Section 8.12 .
blocks.zh: 一项修正法在另一部法律中添加了条文,在其案文中引用,并有自己的条文。 鉴于文章的头部,模型决定了其中的哪一个. 分数是在插入公式后(“passa a vigorar comm a sguinte redação”)和平面文章标题后文本的对数概率差异,并且阈值在培训项目上设置,以平衡准确,这是任务的衡量标准,因为3 095个外部项目中只有313个被插入。 T2被预先登记为确认,并被理解为探索性,理由见第8.12节。

blocks.en: An article is altered by one of four operations, a legal term swapped for its usual counterpart, numbers permuted within the article, a cross-reference changed to another article cited in the act, or the contents of two subdivisions of the same kind, such as two items or two paragraphs, swapped under their labels, one item per operation that applies. The model must prefer the original over the tampered version, with chance at 0.5.
blocks.zh: 一条被四行之一所更改,一个法律名词被交换给通常的对等者,在文章中标出数字,交叉引用被修改为法案中引用的另一条,或者两个同类分行的内容,如两个项或两款,在标签下互换,每行适用一个项. 模型必须更偏好原作而不是被篡改的版本,机能为0.5.

blocks.en: The head of an article is cut at half of its words, and the model scores the real second half given the first, in bits per byte. A sample generated by the model and compared with the real text by surface overlap would be a weaker score, since overlap rewards near-verbatim reproduction and misses meaning kept in other words, a tension documented for translation by large language models in Weigang and Brom [2025] .
blocks.zh: 文章的头部被切成一半的单词,模型给出了第一分数的正后半分,以每字节比特表示. 由模型生成并按表面重叠与真实文本作比较的样本将是一个较弱的分数,因为重叠奖励近于verbatim复制,并错过了用其他语句保留的意义,在Weigang和Brom[2025]中记录了由大语言模型翻译的张力.

blocks.en: The autoregressive mode, the n-gram and the public models score a candidate by the exact log-probability of its tokens. Masked diffusion scores it by the conditional estimator of LLaDA [ Nie et al., 2025 ] , with 128 masks per item drawn with the number of masks stratified and the same masks for all candidates of an item, an upper bound on the negative log-likelihood like the NELBO. An item is discarded if it shares a span of 13 tokens with any training document, so that recitation cannot answer it, and if it does not fit the window of 256 tokens with its context. Table 3 gives the counts.
blocks.zh: 自动递减模式,正克和公用模式以其符号的确切对数概率来评分一名候选人. 假面扩散通过LLaDA [Nie 等人,2025年]的有条件估计器来评分,每件物品抽取128个口罩,口罩分级数量,对一件物品的所有候选者都采用相同的口罩,像NELBO那样在负向日志上具有上限. 如果一个项目与任何培训文件共用13个符号,因此背书无法回答,如果它与256个符号的窗口不匹配其上下文,则该项目将被丢弃。 表3列出数字。

blocks.en: Table 3: Items of the four tasks on the external acts of 2025 and 2026, and the share of groups that must favour the model for a sign test to reach power 0.8 under Holm’s correction in its worst case. The T2 share is kept as preregistered, although its sign test turned out not to measure the balanced accuracy ( Section 8.12 ). T1 holds 308 cross-references and 29 numbers.
blocks.zh: 表3:2025年和2026年四项对外行为任务的项目,以及必须赞成标志测试模式的团体在霍尔姆最糟糕的情况下修正后达到权力0.8的比例. T2份额保留为预先登记,尽管其标志测试结果并不是衡量平衡的准确性(第8.12节)。 T1持有308个交叉引用和29个数字.

blocks.en: The unit is the group, not the item, since the provisions of one act and of the acts that amend it are not independent. The statistic is the mean of the per-group values, which gives each group the same weight, with a 95% interval by a wild cluster bootstrap with Rademacher weights on the group influences, in T2 after linearising the recall of each class. The model beats the floor on a task when a two-sided sign test over the groups rejects at 0.05 in its favour, with Holm’s correction over the comparisons of each track [ Dror et al., 2018 ] , and the analysis is repeated without the largest group. T1 is descriptive. The public models are placed by their intervals, with no pass or fail. The design, the tasks, the item hashes and the decision rule were frozen before any measurement on the external set, and two dated amendments, each frozen by its hash before any score on the external set was computed, enlarged the external set from 300 laws to the 1,094 acts and generated one T3 item per applicable operation, both for power, and removed 13 T2 items that did not fit the window together with the insertion formula. The decrees therefore entered by a rule fixed before the measurement, not by a choice made after it, and the results are reported by genre as well as in total.
blocks.zh: 单位是团体,不是物品,因为一个行为和修改它的行为的规定是不独立的. 统计值是每个组值的平均值,使每个组都具有相同的权重,在将每个组的召回线化后,用一个带有Rademacher对组的影响的权重的野生组团靴来间隔95%。 模型在一项任务上击倒了地板,当两侧的标牌测试对各组表示否定时为 0:5,Holm 更正了对每道的比较[Dror等, 2018], 分析是重复的, 没有最大的组. T1是描述性的. 公用型号由相接相接而起,无过或有出. 设计、任务、项目散列和决定规则在对外部组合进行任何计量之前被冻结;在计算外部组合的任何分数之前,两次日期修正,每次被散列冻结;将外部组合从300个定律扩大至1 094个行为,每次适用操作产生一个T3项,既用于动力,又去除13个与窗口不符的T2项和插入公式。 因此,这些法令是根据计量前确定的规则,而不是根据计量后作出的选择,结果按流派和总数报告。

blocks.en: 6.4 From generator to typed decider
blocks.zh: 6.4 从生成器到打字决定器

blocks.en: A typed decider receives a text and returns a probability distribution over fixed options in one pass, without generating text. Reading T2 and T3 as decisions, the network trained here can serve as the encoder of one, which lets a reader build a decider from scratch with the same pipeline. The states of the last layer, averaged over the tokens of the item, feed a linear head over the options. The autoregressive mode reads with causal attention and the diffusion mode with bidirectional attention and no mask. The whole network is fine-tuned on the training items for 3 epochs with AdamW at its default settings, batch 16, a constant learning rate chosen in { 10 − 5 , 3 × 10 − 5 , 10 − 4 } \{10^{-5},3\times 10^{-5},10^{-4}\} by 5-fold cross-validation grouped by act, and cross-entropy weighted by the inverse class frequency. In T3 each text is judged alone as original or tampered, since a decider sees one input. A temperature is fitted on the out-of-fold logits, calibration is measured by the expected calibration error over 15 bins, and the selective answer abstains below the lowest confidence whose out-of-fold accuracy reaches 95%. The floor is TF-IDF of words and word pairs with balanced logistic regression, its regularisation chosen in the same cross-validation. The public reference is the multilingual Laya decider 1 1 1 convaiinnovations/laya , revision 55cf4c4 , encoder mmBERT-base with 322M parameters. , fine-tuned by the same protocol and also read without fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 一个被键入的决断者收到一个文本,并在一个通道中返回一个对固定选项的概率分布,而不生成文本. 阅读 T2 和 T3 作为决定,在这里训练的网络可以充当一个的编码器,它让一个读者用同样的管道从头开始建立一个决定器. 最后一层的状态,平均在物品的符号上,在选项上喂入一个线性头. 自动后退模式读取有因果关注,传播模式有双向关注而无口罩. 整个网络对3个时代的培训项目进行了微调,AdamW在其默认设置下,第16批,在{10-5, 3- 10- 5, 10- 4}{10- 5} 3\ 时间选择的恒定学习率 10^{-5},10^{-4}\}由5倍的交叉验证按行为组合而成,并被反相类频率加权而成. 在T3中,每个文本单独被判定为原作或被篡改,因为决定者看到一个输入. 温度被安装在双倍对数上,校正用15个垃圾箱上的预期校正误差来测量,选择性的答案则弃用低于其外倍精度达到95%的最低置信度. 该楼层为TF-IDF,以平衡的逻辑回归为词和词对,在相同的交叉验证中选择其正则化. 公众参考多语言的Laya决定器11 1 Convaiinnovations/laya.,修订版55cf4c4,编码器mmBERT-base有322M参数. . 由同一种协议进行微调,并无需微调而读取.

blocks.en: 6.5 Quality of the samples
blocks.zh: 6.5 样品的质量

blocks.en: The quality of generated text is measured at four levels. Level N1, valid words, is automatic, measured against the lexicon of the training partition, since a modern dictionary would mark the period spelling of corpus A as error. Levels N2 (local syntax), N3 (complete grammatical sentence) and N4 (paragraph coherence) need a blind human reading and a semantic judge validated against it, both preregistered and described in Appendix C , and their results are not part of this version. Before any reading, a sample is discarded if it copies from training a span longer than the 99th percentile of the longest span shared between human test excerpts and training [ McCoy et al., 2021 ; Carlini et al., 2022 ] , and the discard rate is reported as a measure of memorisation. This version reports the level N1, the copy filter and two diagnostics. The novelty of word n-grams, for n n from 1 to 10, is the share of the n-grams of a sample absent from training, compared with human test excerpts. The generative perplexity of samples under an external model, here Tucano 630M, is reported beside the entropy of each sample, since a lower effective temperature lowers the first while diversity falls [ Zheng et al., 2024 ] .
blocks.zh: 生成文本的质量在四个层次上进行测量. N1级,有效词是自动的,与训练分区的词典相比衡量,因为现代词典会将命题A的时期拼写标记为出错. N2(局部语法),N3(完整的语法句子)和N4(段落一致性)需要盲文读取和语义判官对它进行验证,两者都是在附录C中预先注册和描述的,其结果不属于本版本. 在读取之前,如果样本从训练中复制的时间长于人类试验节选和培训之间共用最长时间长度的第99百分位数,则该样本将被丢弃[McCoy等人,2021;Carlini等人,2022],弃置率被报告为一种纪念度。 这个版本报告N1级,副本过滤和两个诊断. 对n从1到10的n-gms一词来说,新颖的n-gms是一个没有参加训练的样本n-gms的比例,与人类测试节录相比. 图卡诺630M是外部模型下样品的基因复杂度,在每一个样品的正反面报告,因为低有效温度会降低第一个,而多样性则会下降[郑等,2024]。

blocks.en: 6.6 Calibration
blocks.zh: 6.6 校正

blocks.en: A good model also knows how sure it is. The unit is the prediction of one token, every position given its prefix in the autoregressive mode and every masked position of one draw of l l in diffusion, over 50,000 validation predictions taken from windows in a fixed random order, with the padding after the document’s [EOS] left out. Confidence is the largest softmax probability, and a prediction is correct when it equals the target. A temperature T = 1 / β T=1/\beta is fitted by Newton’s method on the mean negative log-likelihood, which is convex in β \beta , the temperature scaling of Guo et al. [2017] . The expected calibration error averages the gap between confidence and accuracy over 15 equal bins, the reliability diagram plots one against the other, and the area under the ROC curve measures how well confidence separates correct from wrong predictions. The selective answer accepts the predictions above a threshold, the lowest one whose accepted predictions on a calibration half reach a target accuracy by the lower 5% quantile of a Beta distribution, and is then applied to the other half, so that a promise made on one half is checked on the other. blocks.en: The observations in this subsection are descriptive, since only the 256-epoch budget carries a hypothesis test, and they hold for this model and these corpora. The autoregressive mode learns faster. It improves at every budget up to 64 epochs and then degrades sharply, ending at 256 epochs worse than at 4. Masked diffusion barely moves from 1 to 16 epochs, 2.808 to 2.748, and then improves at every budget up to the end of the grid, so the grid does not show where it stops improving. The comparison a reader is most likely to need is between the best point of each mode, 64 epochs for the autoregressive mode and 256 for diffusion, and it was not preregistered. A Welch TOST with margin Δ min \Delta_{\min} , added after the decisive analysis and declared as such, compares the 5 autoregressive seeds with the 6 of diffusion. On validation, where the best points were chosen, diffusion minus autoregressive is 0.019 bits per byte on corpus A, 90% interval [ 0.016 , 0.023 ] [0.016,0.023] , and 0.069 on corpus B, [ 0.064 , 0.074 ] [0.064,0.074] . On test, the less biased reading because no choice was made there, it is 0.060 on corpus A, [ 0.056 , 0.064 ] [0.056,0.064] , which is 66% of Δ min \Delta_{\min} , and 0.061 on corpus B, [ 0.058 , 0.065 ] [0.058,0.065] , 47% of Δ min \Delta_{\min} . Both tests reject at 0.05. Read asymmetrically, as fixed in Section 6 , this says that the diffusion bound is not above the exact autoregressive likelihood by more than Δ min \Delta_{\min} , and that the autoregressive mode is ahead in point estimate, with every interval above zero. It says nothing about equivalence in true likelihood, since the gap between the bound and the true value of diffusion was not measured. For a reader with a small corpus, the practical consequence is that the training budget must be chosen per mode, since the best budget of one is a poor budget for the other.

blocks.en: The pattern agrees in direction with what Prabhudesai et al. [2025] report at larger scale, with 100M unique tokens, where diffusion overtakes the autoregressive mode when data are scarce and repeated, and the half-life of data reuse is about 500 epochs for diffusion against about 31 for the autoregressive mode. Ni et al. [2025] report results in the same direction. On the autoregressive side, Muennighoff et al. [2023] find that up to 4 epochs of repeated data change the loss little compared with unique data and that the value of further repetition decays to zero, and Xue et al. [2023] find that repeated epochs degrade the model and that dropout was the one regulariser among those they tried that proved effective against it. Nie et al. [2024] , in the single-epoch regime, estimate that masked diffusion needs about 16 times the compute of the autoregressive mode to match it, which agrees in direction with the 1-epoch point here. Prabhudesai et al. [2025] attribute the tolerance of diffusion to repetition to masking acting as data augmentation, since each pass over a sequence masks different positions. That mechanism was not tested here.
blocks.zh: 其模式与Prabhudesai等人一致。 [2025]报告规模较大,有100M独有的活符,当数据稀缺并被重复时,扩散会超过自递回模式,数据再利用的半衰期约为500个纪元,而自递回模式的半衰期约为31个. Ni等 [2025] 报告结果相同。 在自递回方面,Muennighoff等 [2023] 发现相较于独有数据,重复数据最多有4个纪元改变损失,再重复衰变值为零;而薛等. [2023]发现,反复的时代让模型退化,辍学是他们尝试的被证明对模型有效的一个常客. Nie等 [2024],在"单纪"制度下,估计被遮住的传播需要自递式模式的大约16倍的计算来匹配,这与这里的"一纪"点一致. Prabhudesai等 [2025] 将扩散的耐受性归结为重复被掩盖为数据增强,因为每次传递一个序列会掩盖不同的位置. 这种机制没有在这里经过试验。

blocks.en: A control at equal compute points the same way. The trivial byte tokenizer of the contract, with 260 ids, was trained in the autoregressive mode with the hyperparameters chosen for that mode, over 3 seeds, and received the total FLOPs of the BPE runs at the 16-epoch and the 256-epoch budgets. A BPE token covers 3.56 bytes of training text on average, so at equal compute the byte model passes over the text fewer times, 0.28 to 0.32 of the BPE epochs. A window of 256 bytes holds less text than a window of 256 BPE tokens, about 911 bytes, so a second arm uses a window of 911 bytes to equalise the context. At the 16-epoch budget the byte model is worse by 0.80 to 1.41 bits per byte. At the 256-epoch budget it is better by about 1.0 bit per byte with either window, reaching 1.84 to 1.85, close to the best autoregressive value of the grid ( Table 5 ). A reading consistent with the grid is that matching compute made the byte model repeat the text 72 to 81 times instead of 256, and so overfit less. This was not measured separately, and a property of byte-level modelling as such cannot be excluded.

blocks.en: 8.7 Why large models are autoregressive
blocks.zh: 8.7 联合国 为什么大模型是自递的

blocks.en: If diffusion wins at 256 epochs on both corpora, a reader may fairly ask why the large language models in wide use are autoregressive. Part of the answer is in the grid. At its own best budget the autoregressive mode is not worse here ( Section 8.3 ), so what diffusion offers in this regime is tolerance to repetition, not a better best point. Large models are trained in the opposite regime, reading far more unique text than they could repeat, with compute as the binding limit, and there Nie et al. [2024] estimate that masked diffusion needs about 16 times the compute of the autoregressive mode to match it, which the 1-epoch points of both grids echo, with the autoregressive mode ahead by 0.115 and 0.871 bits per byte. Causal attention also lets the autoregressive mode cache the keys and values of past tokens, which plain masked diffusion cannot do. Block variants recover the cache [ Arriola et al., 2025 ] , and the speed-up reported for LLaDA 8B over LLaMA 3 8B with its cache is modest, 1.5 to 1.8 times at batch size 1 [ Nie et al., 2025 , Appendix B.7] . And the autoregressive likelihood is exact where diffusion gives a bound. Why a given company keeps its choice is not observable from this work.
blocks.zh: 如果传播在256个纪元上胜出, 读者可能会很公平地问为什么广泛使用的大型语言模型是自旋的。 部分答案在网格内. 以其本身的最佳预算,自动递减模式在此并不更糟糕(第8.3节),因此,这种制度中的传播提议是容忍重复,而不是更好的点子。 大型模型在相反的制度下受到训练,阅读的文本远比它们所能重复的更独特,计算为约束限制,在那里有"尼等". [2024]估计口罩扩散需要自旋模式的大约16倍计算才能与之相匹配,两个网格的1-epoc点都呼应,自旋模式每字节前行0.115和0.871位. 由来注意也让自递式模式缓存过去符号的密钥和值,而平面被遮掩的传播无法做到. 区块变体回收缓存[Arriola等人,2025年],LLaDA 8B的速率报告高于LLaMA 3 8B的缓存,批量大小为1.5至1.8倍 1 [Nie等,2025年.,附录B.7]. 而自相递减的可能性 恰恰是扩散的束缚所在 从这项工作中看不出来,为什么某个公司坚持自己的选择。

blocks.en: The reader of this tutorial is in the regime of the grid, little text read many times, where the choice of budget matters more than the choice of mode. Finding the best point of a mode means training the budget grid, one run per budget with the cosine schedule closed on its own length, and even then the grid locates that point only to within a factor of 4 in epochs. A reader who can pay for the grid can stop the autoregressive mode at its best point. A reader who cannot is better served by diffusion, which did not degrade anywhere in the grid, while the autoregressive mode lost ground on both corpora between 64 and 256 epochs.
blocks.zh: 这个教程的读者处于网格的体系中,很少读出很多次文字,其中预算的选择比模式的选择更重要. 找到一个模式的最佳点意味着培训预算网格,每个预算运行一次,其余弦表按自己的长度关闭,即使这样,网格也只将它定位到一个世纪的4倍之内. 能为网格付费的读者可以在最佳点停止自旋模式. 一个无法通过扩散得到更好服务的读者,在网格中没有降解任何地方,而自旋模式在64至256个纪元之间都失去了两个科普罗拉分.

blocks.en: 8.8 Is the model good?
blocks.zh: 8.8 联合国 模特儿好吗?

blocks.en: On corpus A the honest answer, by likelihood alone, is barely. The 5-gram floor, trained in a few seconds of CPU and scored on the same windows of 256 tokens, reaches 1.841 bits per byte on validation ( Figure 1 ). The autoregressive Transformer is worse than the floor at 1, 4 and 16 epochs, crosses it between 16 and 64, and at its best point, 1.806 at 64 epochs, beats it by 0.035, less than half of Δ min \Delta_{\min} . The diffusion mode at its best point, 1.825 at 256 epochs, beats it by 0.016. A reader who trains a small model on a few hundred thousand tokens and compares it only with other neural runs would not see this. The comparison with the floor is the first check of usefulness, and it costs seconds.
blocks.zh: 老实回答A, 仅是可能性, 几乎是。 5克高地由几秒钟的CPU训练并在同一个256个令牌的窗口上得分,在验证后每字节能达到1.841个比特(图一. 自动后退变形器比地上1,4和16个纪元更糟糕,在16到64个纪元之间交叉,在最佳时段,在64个纪元上相差1.806个纪元,以0.035分击败了它,还不到QQ分/分\Delta_{\min}的一半. 传播模式在其最佳点上,在256个纪元上为1.825个,以0.016相较. 一个在几十万个符号上训练出一个小模型,并且只与其他神经运动相比较的读者不会看到这一点. 与地板的比较是第一次检查是否有用,需要几秒钟。

blocks.en: The floor is a single number, though, and the two models are not good at the same things. Scoring every validation token with both, on the same windows, shows where the Transformer earns its place ( Figure 6 ). Where the exact sequence of five tokens already occurs in training, 6.6% of the tokens, the n-gram wins by 0.54 nats per token, since it recalls repetitions verbatim. Where the context was seen with another continuation, 10.9% of the tokens, the Transformer wins by 0.44 nats per token, which is generalisation from a known context to a new continuation. In the remaining 82.5%, contexts the n-gram never saw, the Transformer wins by 0.08. By frequency, the gain concentrates on tokens seen 10 to 99 times in training. The two models fail in different places, and mixing their probabilities, with the weight fitted on half of the validation documents and measured on the other half, reaches 1.709 bits per byte at 64 epochs, against 1.802 for the Transformer and 1.832 for the n-gram on the same half ( Figure 7 ). The gain of the mixture over the Transformer, 0.093, is the size of Δ min \Delta_{\min} . For a home-built model, the practical lesson is to keep the n-gram and mix, as language modelling did before neural networks and as Liu et al. [2024] do at the scale of trillions of tokens.

blocks.en: 8.9 What the samples show
blocks.zh: 8.9 联合国 样本显示什么

blocks.en: On level N1 the autoregressive samples reach the lexicon rate of human text, 0.941 at 64 epochs and 0.950 at 256 against 0.962 for human test excerpts of the same length, within the preregistered 5 points from 64 epochs on. Diffusion reaches 0.808 and 0.889 and does not meet N1 anywhere in the grid. The novelty of word n-grams at 256 epochs shows two opposite departures from human text. The autoregressive samples reuse more short sequences from training, with 31% of their word bigrams absent from training against 40% for human excerpts, and diffusion invents more, 48%. Generative perplexity under Tucano 630M moves with temperature in both modes as expected ( Figure 8 ). At temperature 1 and 256 epochs it is 179 for the autoregressive mode and 525 for diffusion, at nearly the same entropy, 4.60 and 4.68 nats per token. The lower value of the autoregressive mode agrees with its memorisation, and Machado’s prose is in the public domain and may be in the pretraining data of the scorer, so a low generative perplexity here does not separate quality from recall. No decision rests on these diagnostics, and the levels N2 to N4 await the blind reading.

blocks.en: 8.10 Calibration and deletion
blocks.zh: 8.10 校准和删除

blocks.en: Calibration improves with training and depends on the mode ( Table 7 , Figure 9 ). The autoregressive mode is well calibrated at temperature 1 up to 16 epochs, with an expected calibration error of 0.012 to 0.016 on corpus A, and becomes overconfident as it memorises, 0.106 at 64 epochs and 0.398 at 256, where the fitted temperature, 2.19, brings it back to 0.014. Diffusion stays below 0.04 at every budget of both corpora at temperature 1. In the first budgets, the temperature that minimises the negative log-likelihood can raise the calibration error, from 0.014 to 0.022 at one epoch, since the two criteria differ. Confidence also becomes a better detector of correct predictions with training, the area under the ROC curve rising from 0.65 to 0.79 in the autoregressive mode and from 0.47 to 0.83 in diffusion on corpus A. The selective answer at a 90% target shows what a promise is worth. On corpus A it covers 1.3% of the predictions in the autoregressive mode and 5% in diffusion at 256 epochs, and the promise made on one half holds on the other in 4 of 6 and 6 of 6 seeds. On corpus B, a more repetitive text, it covers up to 49% in the autoregressive mode. Diffusion finds no threshold that reaches the target before 64 epochs on corpus A and before 16 on corpus B.

blocks.en: The deletion curves show how much each prediction depends on its context. Removing the context words ranked as most important drops the probability of the decision much faster than removing words at random, with an area under the curve of 0.080 against 0.328 for the autoregressive mode at 256 epochs on corpus A and 0.149 against 0.605 for diffusion, so the ranking finds the words the decision rests on ( Figure 10 ). With the whole context removed, the remaining relative probability measures how much the model predicts from its own bias. For diffusion on corpus A it stays between 0.83 and 1.0 up to 16 epochs, so the early diffusion model predicts nearly the same token whatever the context, and it falls to 0.19 at 64 epochs and 0.09 at 256 as its likelihood improves.

blocks.en: 8.11 How much text the model needs
blocks.zh: 8.11 联合国 模型需要多少文本

blocks.en: On corpus B the floor is just as close. The 6-gram floor on the same validation windows reaches 1.066 bits per byte, the value of the best autoregressive point to the third decimal, and is better than the best diffusion point ( Figure 3 ). The tie holds on the same windows only, since on running text the floor reaches 1.038 and is ahead. Whether this reflects the method or the amount of text can be measured, since more text is the one resource a reader with a specialist corpus can sometimes add. A preregistered data curve trains the autoregressive mode, at 16 and 64 epochs with 3 seeds and the better budget on validation, and the n-gram on nested fractions of the training groups of corpus B, from one eighth to all of them, and scores both and their mixture on the 300 external laws, on the same windows. The Transformer was to count as worth its cost at a fraction where the lower limit of its gain over the floor passed Δ min \Delta_{\min} .

With 0.55 MB of training text the Transformer is worse than the floor by 0.268 bits per byte, [ 0.232 , 0.305 ] [0.232,0.305] . blocks.en: 8.12 Usefulness on legal tasks
blocks.zh: 8.12 联合国 法律任务的作用

blocks.en: Of the three confirmatory tasks, the model beats the floor in one, loses in one and does not beat it in the third, and the descriptive task favours it ( Table 8 , Figure 12 ). Detecting tampered text, the autoregressive mode beats the floor, with a difference of 0.062, [ 0.014 , 0.110 ] [0.014,0.110] , in favour in 202 of the 356 groups where the two differ, Holm-adjusted p = 0.025 p=0.025 . Masked diffusion has an interval above zero as well, 0.053, [ 0.015 , 0.091 ] [0.015,0.091] , but its sign test does not reject, Holm-adjusted p = 0.13 p=0.13 , so by the preregistered rule it does not beat the floor. Filling in the blank, descriptive by design, the autoregressive mode chooses the right number or cross-reference 0.399 of the time against 0.241 for the floor, a difference of 0.158, [ 0.090 , 0.226 ] [0.090,0.226] , and diffusion, the mode built for this task, gains 0.069, [ 0.011 , 0.128 ] [0.011,0.128] . Completing a provision, both modes are worse than the floor, the autoregressive mode by 0.070 bits per byte, [ 0.056 , 0.085 ] [0.056,0.085] , and the diffusion bound by 0.497, which by the reading of Section 6 says nothing about the true likelihood of diffusion. Telling an inserted provision from one of the law’s own, no mode beats the floor, the autoregressive mode is below it, [ − 0.064 , − 0.005 ] [-0.064,-0.005] , and diffusion ties it, 0.0004 0.0004 , [ − 0.024 , 0.025 ] [-0.024,0.025] . Removing the largest group changes none of these readings.

blocks.en: One reading of T2 departs from the preregistration and is recorded as a deviation made after the measurement. The preregistered rule applies the sign test to the contribution of each group to the balanced accuracy. On the external set, 547 of the 643 groups hold provisions of one class only, and there the difference between two scorers measures only their accuracy on the majority class. The test then rejects with about 85% of the groups in favour of any scorer, whether the balanced accuracy goes up or down, so T2 is read by the interval of the balanced accuracy instead. The output of the original rule is kept in the repository.
blocks.zh: 一次对T2的读取偏离了预先登记,被记录为测量后的偏差. 预先注册的规则对每个组对平衡准确性的贡献应用了标志测试. 在外置设定上,643个组中,有547个组只持有一个等级的规定,有两个计分员之间的分数差只衡量其在多数级的准确性. 然后,测试用85%左右的分组来拒绝任何计分器,无论平衡的准确度是上升还是下降,所以T2读取的是平衡的准确度的间隔. 原始规则的输出保存在寄存器中.

blocks.en: Seven in ten groups of the external set are decrees, a genre absent from training, and the reading changes with the genre ( Table 8 , Figure 12 ). On ordinary laws the advantage in tampered text disappears, 0.613 for the autoregressive mode against 0.611 for the floor over 70 groups, the continuation keeps its order, 1.523 against 1.435, and the public yardsticks, pretrained on much more text, are ahead of the home-built model by point estimate in every task but T2, with 0.716 to 0.816 in tampered text, 0.43 to 0.55 in filling the blank and 0.64 to 0.79 bits per byte in continuation. In decrees the autoregressive mode leads T1 and T3, at 0.412 and 0.551, but there the floor and the yardsticks stay near or below chance, 0.207 to 0.264 in T1 against a chance of 0.25 and 0.404 to 0.544 in T3 against 0.5. The lead in T1 depends on weighting each group equally. Weighting each item instead, the autoregressive mode and Tucano 630M tie over all acts, at 0.401 each. T1 also mixes two classes of very different size, 308 cross-references and 29 numbers, all of the latter in laws, and on numbers the yardsticks lead, 0.52 to 0.76 against 0.35 for the autoregressive mode ( Table 9 ), so no claim is made here for deleted numbers. In T2 every scorer, Tucano 630M included, stays between 0.46 and 0.55 overall, so the task does not separate the scorers.
blocks.zh: 外部组合的十分之七是法令、未参加培训的流派以及随流派的阅读变化(表8,图12)。 在普通法中,篡改文本的优点消失;70多组的自旋模式为0.611; 继续维持其顺序; 1.523对 1.435; 预先对文本进行训练的公用标尺,在每项任务中都比自制模型领先,但T2按点估算; 篡改文本为0.716至0.816; 填入空白为0.43至0.55; 每字节为0.64至0.79。 在法令中,自动递减模式导致T1和T3,以0.412和0.551为主,但有地底和分量的距离接近或低于机会,T1的0.207至0.264为机会,而T3的0.404至0.544为0.5. T1中的领先取决于每个组的权重均匀. 反之,每件东西的重量,自动递减模式和Tucano 630M 在所有行为上都是平分的,每件0.401. T1还混合了两种大小迥异的类别,308个相参照和29个数字,后者都在法律中,在数字上标出"铅",0.52到0.76对自递性模式的0.35(表9),因此此处没有为被删除的数字提出索赔. 在T2中,每个计分员,图卡诺630M包含,总体停留在0.46到0.55之间,因此任务没有将计分员分开.

blocks.en: Scorers near or below chance point to items that a likelihood score gets systematically wrong, so the stored choices were examined for three causes, with no new run ( Table 9 ). The first is surface frequency, the competition among surface forms that Holtzman et al. [2021] correct with a conditional pointwise mutual information score, not applied here. The value that tells the candidates apart was counted in the training text of corpus B, which the home-built models and the floor learned from and the yardsticks never saw, so the measure is asymmetric by construction. The home-built models and the floor pick the most frequent of the four options of T1 in 0.48 to 0.69 of the items, against 0.24 to 0.31 for the yardsticks and 0.33 for the right answer being the most frequent. Their accuracy follows that prior. When the right answer is the most frequent option the autoregressive mode is right in 0.564 of the items and otherwise in 0.321, diffusion in 0.673 and 0.147 and the floor in 0.450 and 0.164, while the yardsticks barely change, at 0.35 to 0.39 when it is not and 0.37 to 0.41 when it is. In T3 the preference for the more frequent of the two versions separates only the home-built modes, 0.68 and 0.70, from the floor and the yardsticks, 0.42 to 0.59, against a base rate of 0.55.
blocks.zh: 概率接近或低于概率的计分者指出一个概率分数被系统错误的项目,因此对所储存的选择进行了三个原因的审查,没有新的运行(表9 ). 第一种是地表频率,地表形态之间的竞争由Holtzman等所决定. [2021] 以有条件的点入相通信息分数正确,在此不适用. 将候选人区分开来的价值在B项的训练文本中计算出来,自建模型和地板从中汲取了教训,标准也从未看到过,因此,衡量标准在建筑上不对称。 土建模型和地平线选取了其中0.48至0.69中T1四个选项中最常选取的,而标尺0.24至0.31,正确答案0.33是最常选取的. 其准确性是先于此。 当正确的答案是最常见的选项时,自递式模式在0.564项中正确,在0.321项中正确,在0.673和0.147分被扩散,在0.450和0.164分被下层分被扩散,而分被度量法几乎没有改变,在0.35至0.39分中不改变,在0.37至0.41分中不改变. 在T3中,倾向于更频繁地使用两种版本,只将自建模式从地平面和标尺0.42到0.59分开,而基率为0.55.

blocks.en: The second cause is the weight of small groups. Each group weighs the same, and 67 of the 104 decree groups of T1 and 265 of the 396 of T3 hold a single item, nearly all of them cross-references. In those single-item decrees of T1 the yardsticks score 0.18 to 0.19, at chance by a one-sided binomial test over the 67 items ( p p from 0.11 to 0.18), and only the floor, at 0.149, is below it ( p = 0.034 p=0.034 ). In those of T3 the floor and the two Tucano models are below chance, 0.29 to 0.43 over 265 items ( p ≤ 0.02 p\leq 0.02 ), and TeenyTinyLlama, at 0.475, is not. In the larger decree groups the scorers are at or above chance in T1, the yardsticks and the home-built modes at 0.34 to 0.42, and all of them are above chance in T3, from 0.58 to 0.70.

blocks.en: The third cause concerns what the home-built model knows. A decree regulates a law, the law whose article it cites may be in the training text of corpus B, and the 13-token filter removes an item only when its wording is copied. Classifying the cross-references of decrees in T1 by the act named right after the gap, 38 point to a law of the training partition, 53 to another law and 5 to the decree itself, and 135 name no act there. On the 38 the autoregressive mode is right in 0.511 of the items, against 0.374 on the 53, while the floor, diffusion and the yardsticks score from 0.026 to 0.184 on them. Part of the advantage of the autoregressive mode in decrees therefore comes from knowing the laws they regulate, not from generalising to a new genre, a reading that rests on a heuristic classification and few items. Why the other scorers prefer the distractors on those items was not established, so the validity of the T1 and T3 items on decrees is not established either, and the advantages of the home-built model that come from the decrees are reported as such, not as evidence of usefulness.
blocks.zh: 第三个原因是自建模型知道什么。 一项法令规定了一项法律,它所援引的法律条款可能载于B号令状的训练文本中,13个字的过滤器只有在其措辞被复制时才会删除。 将T1中法令的相互参照按空白后命名的法案进行分类,38指训练分治法,53指其他法律,5指法令本身,135指该地没有法案的名称. 在38号线上,自递式模式在其中的0.511个线上正确,而53号线上为0.374个线上,而地平线,扩散线和标尺的得分从0.026分到0.184分. 因此,法令中自动递减模式的优势部分来自了解它们所规范的法律,而不是从概括到新的流派,这种读取依赖于高压分类和很少的项目. 为何其他得分者更喜欢这些物品上的分心者没有确定,因此法令上的T1和T3物品的有效性也没有确定,法令中产生的自建型号的优点被报告为这样,而不是作为有用性的证据.

blocks.en: Scores alone hide what each of them cost. Figure 13 places every scorer by the compute of its training run, approximated by 6 ​ N ​ D 6ND with N N parameters and D D token positions seen in training, the tokens, energy and parameters of the yardsticks taken from their papers [ Corrêa et al., 2024a ; Corrêa et al., 2024b ] . A scorer is on the Pareto frontier when no cheaper one scores higher, and the floor enters the frontier at the left edge, since it trains in seconds on one CPU core. The yardsticks cost about 5 × 10 2 5\times 10^{2} to 10 5 10^{5} times the compute of the home-built autoregressive model and about 10 3 10^{3} to 7 × 10 4 7\times 10^{4} times its energy, orders of magnitude rather than exact ratios. The two energies are not measured the same way, an upper bound for the GPU at the power cap here and the values reported by the authors for the yardsticks, so that ratio is an order of magnitude. The five models are ordered the same way by parameters, compute, energy and wall time, so the frontier does not depend on which of these measures the cost. Over all acts, in T1 the home-built autoregressive model is the whole frontier after the floor, ahead of every yardstick, although its interval touches that of Tucano 630M and the lead becomes a tie with it when items rather than groups are weighted, and in T3 it shares the frontier with TeenyTinyLlama 160M, whose point estimate is higher by 0.008 at about 500 times the compute, with overlapping intervals. Both readings are carried by the decrees, where the floor and the yardsticks are near or below chance. On ordinary laws alone every yardstick is ahead of the home-built model by point estimate in T1, T3 and T4, and on a frontier drawn for the laws the home-built model would stay only as the cheapest neural point, by 0.036 over the floor in T1 and 0.002 in T3. In T4 both home-built modes fall off the frontier, below the cheaper floor, and the frontier is made of the floor and the three yardsticks. In T2 the frontier moves by differences inside the noise, and masked diffusion sits on it by 0.0004 over the floor. The frontier uses point estimates, so a scorer on it whose interval overlaps a neighbour’s is tied with it, and the reading carries the asymmetries of scale and domain set out in Section 11 .

blocks.en: 8.13 A typed decider from the same network
blocks.zh: 8.13 页:1 一个来自同一网络的输入决定器

blocks.en: The network turns into a typed decider with a short module, but in this experiment the decider is not better than the lexical floor ( Table 10 ). In T2 the deciders on both modes reach 0.499 and 0.488 against 0.544 for TF-IDF, and in T3 they stay at chance, 0.501 and 0.514 against 0.573. The cross-validation on training items already showed it, 0.49 to 0.51 at every learning rate in T3, and the multilingual Laya, an encoder of 322M parameters fine-tuned by the same protocol, fails the same way, 0.485 and 0.500, so the failure cannot be attributed to the home-built network alone.
blocks.zh: 网络变成一个带有短模块的打字决定器,但在这个实验中,决定器并不比词汇层更好(表10. 在T2中,两种模式的决策者分别达到0.499和0.488对TF-IDF的0.544,在T3中,他们停留在偶然中,0.501和0.514对0.573. 对训练物品的交叉验证已经显示,在T3的每个学习速率下,0.49到0.51,多语种Laya,由同一种协议微调的322M参数组成的编码器,同样失败了,0.485和0.500,因此失败不能单独归咎于自建网络.

blocks.en: Sanity checks run after the measurement, on the first seed of each mode, separate a broken pipeline from a failed training ( scripts/sanidade_decisor.py ). Fine-tuned on 32 training texts, half of each class, for 300 full-batch steps, the decider fits them exactly at every learning rate of the grid and at 10 − 3 10^{-3} , in both modes and both tasks, with a final loss below 10 − 3 10^{-3} , so the module can learn. Under the protocol, the outcome differs by task. In T2 the training loss falls and the decider reaches a balanced accuracy of 0.79 and 0.74 on its own training items, so it learns them and does not carry what it learned to the external acts. In T3 the training loss stays between 0.69 and 0.76 from the first to the last of the 315 steps, around ln ⁡ 2 ≈ 0.693 \ln 2\approx 0.693 , the balanced accuracy on the training items is 0.51 and 0.50, and the predictions collapse towards one class, with the share of texts called tampered on the external set ranging from 0 to 1 across seeds. That is the signature of a constant predictor, compatible with training that did not succeed under three epochs at a constant rate of at most 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and its cause is not attributed here.
blocks.zh: 测量后,在每种模式的第一个种子上,将中断的管道与失败的训练分开(脚本/sanidade_decisor.py.). 对32个训练文本进行了精细的校正,每班有一半,300个全相接步骤,决定者在网格的每个学习速度和10~3 10~3 → 3 → 3 → 两种任务中都精确地适合它们,最终损失低于10~3 10~3 → 3 → 3 ),所以模块可以学习. 根据协议,结果因任务而异. 在T2中,训练损失会下降,决定者在自己的训练项目上达到0.79和0.74的平衡准确度,因此它学习它们,而不将它学到的东西带给外部行为. 在T3中,从315个步骤中的第一个步骤到最后一个步骤的训练损失在0.69至0.76之间,大约在INT 2 = 0.693 = 2 = 0.693左右,训练项目的均衡准确度为0.51和0.50,预测会向一个班级倒塌,外接的文字被称作被篡改的比例从0到1不等。 这就是一个恒定预测器的签名,它与三个世纪以下没有成功的训练相兼容,其恒定速度最多为10 - 4 10 - 4 Q 4 },其原因在此没有被归结。

blocks.en: Calibration says the same thing from another side. In T3 the fitted temperature reaches the end of its search range, e 4 e^{4} , which flattens every probability to about 0.5, and the calibration error falls near zero. A decider that knows nothing and says so is well calibrated, so a low calibration error is meaningful only next to the accuracy. In T2 the temperature lowered the error in 7 of the 11 runs. The selective answer, with its threshold fixed out of fold on training for 95% accuracy, covers at most 2.3% of the external items on average, and the covered items reach 0.51 to 0.89, so a threshold learned on the training laws does not carry over to acts of another period and genre.
blocks.zh: 校正从另一边也这么说 在T3中,所安装的温度达到其搜索范围的末端,e 4 e^{4},将每种概率平分到0.5左右,而校正误差会降至接近于0. 一个无所不知并说出如此的裁判员是精准校正的,因此低校正误差只在精度旁边才有意义. 在T2中,温度降低了11跑中的7跑的误差. 选择性的答案,其培训门槛定在95%的准确度之外,平均覆盖最多2.3%,覆盖的项目达到0.51至0.89,因此在培训法上学到的门槛不会延续到另一个时期和流派的行为。

blocks.en: 8.14 Synthesis

The question of the tutorial has a measured answer. A language model of 11 to 12M parameters, built from nothing on a home GPU in minutes per run, reaches the level of a well-smoothed n-gram scored on the same windows, ties it on the legal corpus and passes it once the two are mixed. On acts it has never seen, its autoregressive mode does not complete provisions better than counting does. It beats the n-gram at detecting tampered text, and fills deleted cross-references more often than the n-gram and public models of 160M and 630M parameters, only in decrees, a genre absent from training, where those scorers stay near or below chance and where the validity of the items is not established. That advantage rests in part on a frequency prior learned from its training text and on knowing the laws that the decrees regulate, and in filling the blank it holds only when each group weighs the same. On ordinary laws the public models are ahead. None of this is a reason not to brew one. It is the map a reader needs before brewing, since the same scripts that produced these numbers will say, for a new corpus, where the home-built model earns its place. More text, together with the compute that comes with it, is the clearest lever measured here, and the mixture with the n-gram is the cheapest gain. Between the two modes, the choice is one of budget. At their best points, on test, the diffusion bound is above the autoregressive likelihood by less than the minimum effect. The autoregressive mode learns faster and memorises its training text when read too many times, which shows in its likelihood, in its calibration and in its samples, while masked diffusion tolerates repetition and reaches its best point later, an ordering at 256 epochs that holds on the test partition and across the factors varied here. The blind reading, the semantic judge and the reproduction on the T4 are designed, with their criteria frozen, and enter a later version.
blocks.zh: 修行之问有分明之解. 一个由11到12M参数组成的语言模型,从每跑几分钟的家用GPU上一无所取而成,达到同一窗口上良好平分的正克分数的水平,将其与法体相接并被两者混合后通过. 对于它从未见过的行为,其自动递减模式并没有比计数更好的完成规定。 它在检测被篡改的文字时胜过正克,并比160M参数和630M参数的正克和公用模型更频繁地填入被删除的交叉引用,仅在法令中,一个没有参加训练的流派,在这些流派中,得分者接近或低于机会,且物品的有效性没有确定. 这一优势部分在于以前从其培训文本中学到的频率,以及了解法令规定的法律,在填补空白时,只有每个群体都具有同样的重量。 在普通法律方面,公共模式领先。 这些都不是不酿酒的理由。 这是读者在酿造前需要的地图,因为制作这些数字的同一批剧本会说,对于一个新体格来说,由自建模型来赚取它的位置. 更多的文字,加上与之相伴随的计算,是这里所测量的最清晰的杠杆,而与正克相混合是最便宜的收益. 在两种模式之间,选择是预算。 在它们的最佳点上,在测试时,扩散束缚会以低于最小效果而高于自旋概率. 自动回放模式学习得更快,在读取过多次时会记忆起它的训练文字,这在它的可能性,校正和样本中都显示出来;而被遮住的扩散则能容忍重复,并在后期达到最佳点,在测试分区和各种因素之间维持256个时段的订单在这里各不相同. 盲读,语义判断和T4上的再生被设计出,其标准被冻结,并进入后期版本.

blocks.en: 9 Checks that keep defects out of the numbers
blocks.zh: 第9条 检查数字中的缺陷

blocks.en: A pipeline written by hand will contain defects, and many of them do not stop the code from running. They change a number. Table 11 lists the checks that detected a defect in this project, what each one detected and the fix. Most of these defects are known in the literature, and a reader who builds their own pipeline is likely to meet several of them, which is why each check is part of the package and runs again after every change.
blocks.zh: 由手写的管道将包含缺陷,其中许多不会阻止代码运行. 他们改变一个数字。 表11列出了在该项目中发现缺陷的检查、每个项目发现的缺陷和修复情况。 这些缺陷大多被文献所知晓,一个自建管线的读者很可能会遇到其中的几个,这就是为什么每次检查都是包的一部分,每次改变后再次运行的原因.

blocks.en: Table 11: Checks that detected a defect during construction, with what was measured and the fix adopted. Numbers come from the tests and scripts of the repository.
blocks.zh: 表11:在施工过程中发现缺陷的检查,测量结果和采用的固定方法。 数字来自寄存器的测试和脚本.

blocks.en: The precision sentinel compares, tensor by tensor, the gradient in fp16 with the gradient in fp32 on fixed probe batches, from the start to the end of training. In the calibration runs the network had no dropout, and the sentinel passed with a worst per-tensor error of 0.0025 in the autoregressive mode and 0.0099 in diffusion. The hyperparameter search then chose dropout of 0.2 and 0.1, and in the first final runs the same sentinel reported a median per-tensor error of 1.38 and 1.45 and a maximum of 7.11. Every one of the twelve runs exceeded the margin of 0.05, which by the preregistered rule would have removed all of them from the comparison. The cause was in the sentinel. Both backward passes ran in training mode, each drew its own dropout mask, and the error measured the distance between two masks rather than two precisions. With both passes in eval mode, the median error fell to 0.0020 and 0.0046 and the maximum to 0.0049 and 0.0346 ( Figure 14 ). The final runs were repeated with the corrected sentinel, and the estimate of Δ \Delta moved from − 1.028 -1.028 to − 1.026 -1.026 . A unit test now fails if the sentinel runs with dropout on. An instrument validated in one configuration needs to be validated again when the configuration changes.
blocks.zh: 精密的哨兵将Fp16中的梯度与固定探测器批量上的fp32中的梯度相提并论,从训练开始到训练结束. 在校准运行中,网络没有辍学,哨兵通过时,每发分差最差的误差为自转模式为0.0025分,扩散模式为0.0099分. 然后,超参数搜索选择了0.2和0.1的退出率,在首个决赛中,同一哨兵报告每分10分的中值误差为1.38和1.45,最高误差为7.11. 12次跑跑中每一次都超过了0.05分之差,按照预先登记的规则,这可以使所有跑跑跑都脱离比较范围. 原因在哨兵队 两道后行道均以训练模式运行,每道都自画出出出道口罩,误差测量出两道口罩相去相去相去甚远,而不是两道精度相去甚远. 由于两者均以eval模式通过,中间误差已降至0.0020和0.0046,最高误差为0.0049和0.0346(图14. 最终的运行与修正的哨兵相接而来,QQ\Delta的估算从−1.028-1.028转移到−1.026-1.026. 单位测试失败了 如果哨兵有退伍 在一个配置中验证的仪器需要在配置改变时再次验证.

blocks.en: Figure 14: Cumulative distribution of the per-tensor p95 relative error between fp16 and fp32 gradients over all sentinel records of the 12 final runs at 256 epochs. Dashed, the sentinel in training mode, where each pass draws its own dropout mask. Solid, the sentinel in eval mode. The vertical line is the preregistered margin of 0.05.
blocks.zh: 图14:在256个历程中,12个终极跑道的所有哨点记录上,fp16和fp32梯度之间的每克特尔p95相对误差的累计分布. Dashed, 训练模式下的哨兵, 每道通行证都抽取自己的退学口罩. 固态,以eval模式的哨兵. 垂直线为已预先注册的0.05比值.

blocks.en: An autoregressive model pays for the end of a document through the probability of [EOS] . A diffusion model that receives its input already cut to the document’s length does not, and the comparison would then favour diffusion by up to log 2 ⁡ L \log_{2}L bits per document. The package test builds documents of random length with exact conditionals, so that the two modes differ only in how they handle length. The advantage of diffusion equals the entropy of the length distribution within 10 − 9 10^{-9} and vanishes when both modes predict the padding, at the price of 12.2% of the training positions.
blocks.zh: 自动后退模式通过[EOS]的概率支付文档的结尾. 接收其输入到文档长度的传播模式并不如此,因此比较后将有利于通过每个文档的对数2 ++L\log2}L位进行传播。 包测试以精确的条件构建随机长度的文档,这样两种模式仅在如何处理长度上有所不同. 扩散的优势等于长度分布在10-9 10-X-9 以12.2%的训练职位的价格在两种模式预测粘接时消失。

blocks.en: In the search, the autoregressive mode without dropout and with learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} reached 5.6 bits per byte on validation after 256 epochs, far worse than after 16. Its samples changed in the same direction. Over 16 samples of 256 tokens per run, the longest span copied from training had a median of 4 words at 16 epochs and of 144 to 150 words at 256, with a maximum of 180. With dropout 0.2 and learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , the median at 256 epochs fell to 5 to 5.5 words, with isolated samples of 44 and 95 copied words. A fluent sample can therefore be a copy, which is why samples are filtered by copy before any reading or semantic scoring.
blocks.zh: 在搜索中,自动递减模式没有辍学,且学习率10−3 10^{-3}在256个纪元后,在验证时达到每字节5.6位,远比16后差. 它的样品也朝同一方向变化. 每跑超过16个样本256个令牌,从训练中复制的时间最长的中位数为:16个纪元时为4个字;256个纪元时为144至150个字,最高为180个. 由于辍学率为0.2,学习率为3×10-4 3\times 10^{-4}256个世纪的中位数下降到5到5.5个字,孤立样本为44个和95个被复制的字. 因此,流利的样本可以是副本,这就是为什么在读取或语义评分之前,样本通过副本过滤出来的原因.

blocks.en: 10 Adapting the tutorial to a new domain
blocks.zh: 10 使教程适应新域

blocks.en: The steps below move the pipeline to a new corpus. Each step has a recipe in the cookbook of the repository. 1. Write the domain adapter that produces documents with an identifier, a group and the cleaned text, normalised to NFC. 2. Split by group into training, validation and test, and measure the size of each partition. 3. Train the tokenizer on the training partition and choose V V by the rule of absent tokens on the validation text. 4. Measure the padding fraction for candidate window lengths and fix L L . 5. Run the formulation checks on CPU and measure the throughput of the machine. 6. Search the learning rate and dropout on the new corpus, freeze Δ min \Delta_{\min} , run the pilot and derive the number of seeds. 7. Train the budget grid in each mode and evaluate likelihood, the references, the tasks of the domain and the quality of the samples. The tasks of a new domain follow the same pattern as the legal ones. Collect an external set dated after the training text and after the public models in use, grouped by the same rule. Derive each task from the text alone, by deleting a span that the domain fixes, such as a number or a reference, by altering it with operations that keep its surface plausible, or by cutting it, so that no labelling is needed. Discard items that share a long span with training and items that do not fit the window. Count items and groups, compute the power of the sign test over groups, and freeze the design, the item hashes and the decision rule before scoring anything. Check that the test of each task measures its metric when the classes are unbalanced within groups, as T2 here shows it may not.
blocks.zh: 以下步骤将输油管移到一个新的实体。 每一个步骤在寄存器的烹饪本中都有食谱. 1. 将生成带有标识符的文件的域适配器,组和被清理的文本写入正版为NFC. 2. 按组分分为训练,鉴定和试验,并测量每个分区的大小. 3.在训练分区上训练示意器,并按验证文本上缺号的规则选择V V. 4. 测量候选窗口长度的粘接分数并修正LL. 5. 对CPU进行配方检查并测量机器的吞吐量。 6. 搜索新体能的学习率和辍学率,冻结分数(分数),运行飞行员并得出种子数量。 7. 在每个模式中培训预算网格,评价可能性、参考、域内任务和样本质量。 新域的任务遵循与法律相同的方式. 收集培训文本之后和使用的公共模式之后的外部集,按同一规则分类。 仅从文本中衍生出每项任务,方法是删除域固定的跨度,例如数字或参考,用保持其表面合理性的操作来修改,或者剪切,这样就不需要标签了. 丢弃与培训有长距离共享的项目和与窗口不符的项目。 计数项目和组,计算标志测试对组的威力,并在对任何东西进行评分前冻结设计,项目散列和决定规则. 请检查每个任务的测试在类组内部不平衡时测量其度量, 正如这里的T2所示。

blocks.zh: 写入生成带有标识符的文档的域适配器,组和被清理的文本,实现NFC的正态化.

blocks.zh: 按组分分为训练,验证和测试,并测量每个分区的大小.

blocks.en: Train the tokenizer on the training partition and choose V V by the rule of absent tokens on the validation text.
blocks.zh: 在训练分区上训练示意器,在验证文本上按照缺号规则选择V V.

blocks.zh: 测量候选窗口长度的粘贴分数并修正 L 。
