blocks.en: 11 Limitations
blocks.zh: 11 限制

blocks.en: The model has 12.3M parameters and the main corpus 0.62M training tokens, and nothing here transfers to larger scale without new measurement. The claims on corpus A hold for unseen chapters of works whose other chapters were in training, proper names cross the blocks, and the analysis that leaves a whole work out is secondary. For diffusion, the reported likelihood is a bound whose gap to the true value is not measured at this scale, so a result in which the autoregressive mode wins says nothing about the true likelihood of diffusion.
blocks.zh: 该模型有12.3M参数和主体0.62M训练符,没有新的测量,这里没有任何东西转移到更大的规模. 对A类未见的作品的主张,其他章节都在培训中,适当的名称横跨各个街区,而留下整个工作的分析是次要的。 对于扩散,报告的可能性是一个束缚,其与真实值的差距没有在这个尺度上进行测量,因此,自动递减模式获胜的结果对扩散的真实可能性没有任何说明.

blocks.en: On corpus A the bootstrap failed its coverage check, so the result at 256 epochs rests on a randomization test over 6 seeds whose smallest attainable p p is 0.031. Every seed agreed in sign by a wide margin, but a test at its floor cannot express more evidence than that. One amendment was made after seeing data and is recorded as such, and the comparison of the best points of the two modes, by TOST, was added after the decisive analysis. The margins of the sentinel, the threshold of 10% in the vocabulary rule, the coverage minimum and the agreement threshold of the reading have no source and are choices declared before the measurements they govern. The hyperparameter grid constrains the result at 256 epochs, as discussed in Section 8.3 .
blocks.zh: 甲状腺素检查失败,所以在256个纪元时,结果取决于对6个种子的随机测试,其可达到的最小p为0.031。 每一个种子都以很宽的距离签署协议,但是在它的地层进行测试,不能比这表达出更多的证据. 一项修正是在看到数据后作出的,并记录成这样,在决定性的分析之后,增加了TOST对两种模式最佳点的比较。 哨兵的边际,词汇规则中10%的阈值,覆盖率的最小值和读取的协议阈值没有源头,是在其治理的测量之前宣布的选择. 如第8.3节所讨论,超参数网限制了256个纪元的结果。

blocks.en: The levels N2 to N4, the semantic judge and the reproduction on the T4 are not part of this version, so nothing here says how coherent the samples are beyond the lexical level or how long the runs take on Colab. When measured, the levels will depend on a reading by three raters, two of them students who may lack training in nineteenth-century spelling, and the controls limit but do not remove the damage. The sensitivity analysis changed one factor at a time with 3 seeds on corpus A only. The calibration error at the fitted temperature is measured on the predictions used to fit it, one parameter on 50,000 predictions, and only the selective check is evaluated on held-out predictions. The generative perplexity uses a scorer that may have seen the prose of corpus A in pretraining. Corpus B validation and test hold 21 and 19 laws, and the group of the Civil Code holds 53% of the test bytes, which is why usefulness is measured on the external acts. Seven in ten of those acts are decrees, a genre absent from training, so the task results mix the transfer to a new period with the transfer to a new genre, and the per-genre readings rest on fewer groups. In the decrees the floor and the yardsticks stay at chance in T1 and partly below it in T3, concentrated in single-item groups of cross-references, and the validity of those items is not established. The home-built model also leans on how often a candidate occurs in its training text and on knowing the laws that the decrees regulate, a score corrected for surface frequency was not tried, and the classification of the cited acts is a heuristic over few items. The audit of the class rule over 72 sampled summaries, which governs the selection of laws in corpus B, is pending. In T2 the preregistered sign test did not measure the balanced accuracy, and the reading by interval was chosen after the measurement. The decider used the default settings of its optimiser, a constant learning rate and three epochs for every model, and a protocol tuned per model might change its result, for the home-built network and for Laya alike. The external acts postdate the public yardsticks, but their wording repeats earlier laws that those models may have seen. The peak throughput behind the utilisation figures comes from secondary sources and was not checked against the vendor’s documentation, so those figures are approximate.
blocks.zh: N2到N4的等级,语义判断和T4上的复制不属于这个版本,所以这里没有说出样本的一致程度是否超越了词汇级别或者Colab的运行时间. 在测量时,关卡会取决于由三个测出者进行读取,其中两个是可能缺乏十九世纪拼写训练的学生,控制限制但不去除损伤. 灵敏度分析一次改变一个因素,只有3个种子在A体上。 适配温度的校正误差根据适配温度的预测来测量,5万个预测上的一个参数,只有选择性的检查才能被评价被搁置的预测. 基因迷惑性使用一个记分器,该记分器在预训中可能已经看到体A的道词. 企业 B验证和测试持有21和19个法律,而"民法典"的组别持有53%的测试字节,这就是为什么用外部行为来衡量用途的原因. 其中十分之七的法案是法令,是没有参加培训的流派,因此任务结果将转入新时期与转入新流派混合,而每流派的阅读则停留在较少的群体上. 在法令中,T1的下限和尺度是偶然的,T3的下限部分集中在单项对照组,而这些项目的有效性没有确定。 土建模式还着眼于一名候选人在培训文本中经常出现的情况,以及了解法令规定的法律,没有尝试纠正地表频率的分数,对所引用的行为的分类在少数项目上是无休止的。 对关于选择B项法律的72项抽样摘要的分类规则的审计尚未进行。 在T2中,预先注册的标志测试没有测量平衡的准确性,在测量后选择了以间隔读取. 裁决者使用其选取器的默认设置,每个模型的恒定学习率和三个时代,每个模型的调制协议可能会改变结果,对于自建网络和Laya来说都是如此。 外部行为是在公共衡量标准之后发生的,但其措辞重复了这些模式可能已经看到的早先的法律。 使用数字背后的最高吞吐量来自次要来源,没有与供应商的文件核对,因此这些数字是大致的。

blocks.en: The comparison with the public yardsticks is not between equals, on two axes that pull in opposite directions. In scale, the yardsticks are 14 to 57 times larger and saw far more text, about 3.75B tokens for TeenyTinyLlama 160M (8,192 tokens per batch over 458,000 steps, Corrêa et al., 2024a , Table 3 ) and 169B and 211B tokens for Tucano 160M and 630M [ Corrêa et al., 2024b , Table 5] , against 105M token positions for the home-built autoregressive model at its best budget on corpus B. Their training compute, approximated by 6 ​ N ​ D 6ND , is therefore about 5 × 10 2 5\times 10^{2} to 10 5 10^{5} times larger. The token counts come from different tokenizers and give orders of magnitude, not exact ratios. In domain, the home-built model trained on the laws of corpus B, while the yardsticks were used as released, without adaptation, although the training corpus of Tucano holds more than 4B tokens from the legal domain [ Corrêa et al., 2024b ] . The task results therefore do not separate the effect of building from scratch from the effect of training in the domain. Where the home-built model falls short, in the continuation task and on the laws in T3, the gap may come from the amount of training, from the architecture and its specification (six layers of width 384, a window of 256 tokens, a vocabulary of 1,024), or from both, and none of these causes was tested here. The control that would separate them, a public model of similar size adapted on the same training text with the same budget, was not run, and a Portuguese legal model such as RoBERTaLexPT [ Garcia et al., 2024 ] is a candidate for it.

blocks.en: The design below is preregistered in preregistro/m9_leitura.json , SHA-256 be22ed9a , and its results are not part of this version. Three raters read, blind to the origin, crops of 60 words taken from a random position of model samples, of human test excerpts and of word-shuffled excerpts, the last two as controls. A frozen rubric assigns the levels N2 (local syntax), N3 (complete grammatical sentence) and N4 (paragraph coherence). Agreement must reach a Krippendorff’s α \alpha [ Krippendorff, 2011 ] of at least 0.667, and a level counts at a budget only if at least 10 of 12 items reach it. The automatic measure under study is a local language model acting as judge with an anchored rubric for the same levels, the design that Brom et al. [2026] used, with a panel of judges and repeated runs, to measure traits of model responses, where anchored semantic rubrics are distinguished from embedding-based evaluators. Grading by a large model is also the evaluation of TinyStories [ Eldan and Li, 2023 ] . The judge is adopted only if it passes thresholds frozen before the measurement, a lower limit of 0.3 for the 95% interval of the Spearman correlation per item with the blind reading, at least 80% of the human ceiling measured by leaving one rater out, and an area under the ROC curve of at least 0.95 separating human text from shuffled and repetitive text.
blocks.zh: 以下设计被预先注册于pregistro/m9_leitura.json., SHA-256 be22ed9a中,其结果不属于本版本. 三个评分员读取了,对起源视而不见,收了60个字的收成,取自模型样本的随机位置,取出人类测试节录和文字活化节录,后两个作为控制. 被冻结的路由指定等级为N2(本地语法),N3(完整的语法句)和N4(段落一致性). 协议必须达到至少为0.667的Krippendorff的α-alpha[Krippendorff,2011年],只有在12个项目中至少有10项达到时,预算水平才算得上。 正在研究的自动测量是作为法官的当地语言模型,其定位标点相同,即Brom等人的设计。 [2026] 利用由评委组成的评委小组和重复跑来测量模型响应的特质,其中锚定语义分词与嵌入式评价者区分. 由一大型模型来升级也是对TinyStories的评价[Eldan and Li, 2023]. 只有在测量前超过被冻结的阈值,每件与盲读的斯皮尔曼关联的95%间距下限为0.3分,至少通过留出一个评分符来测量人上限的80%,以及ROC曲线下至少将人文文本与被打乱和重复文本相分离的面积为0.95分.
